title: Dynamic fluctuations of emotional states in adolescents with delayed sleep phase—A longitudinal network modeling approach
limitations: - DSP was based only on one out of three diagnostic criteria of the full disorder (DSM-5) and it was assessed only once.
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether the study was preregistered. However, the study is part of the SleepHelsinki! project, which may have been preregistered. The code and data are declared available in the supplementary materials.
